lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Halo's lit, crate's gone, and the bench trainer is in the corner where she always is.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Sit with the trainer. She will not offer twice and she has never offered once before.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Everyone in here is for publishing and none of us has a vote. Same as it ever was.
